reason: My people already pick up most calls, and paying 2,000 $ up front before I know a robot won't mess up a Laval customer who switches between French and English mid-sentence is too big a bet. One wrong answer or a botched appointment costs me more than a missed call that goes to voicemail.
objection: That it says something wrong to a customer or gets the booking details mixed up, and I only find out when the customer is already gone. The setup fee means I'm paying a lot before I've seen it work on my real calls.
would_change_my_mind: A trial on my real line for a few weeks with no setup fee, where I can read every call transcript and see it handle bilingual callers without mistakes.
